exact_items: Make the owner-doc distinction explicit: inspection/provenance refs stay in event and record payloads; route/open contracts own navigation identity.
Keep detail_ref, report_ref, evidence_ref, usage_event_ref, workflow_refs, docker_refs, kubernetes_refs as record/provenance families, not route payload surrogates.
